entries.20ab87c9c785d551: It manufactures and sells machine tools such as NC lathes, machining centers, multitasking machines and NC grinders. It develops in-house the numerical control devices (NC devices) that control machine tools and, based on its “Kiden-jochi” technology, which integrates machinery, electrical (control), information and knowledge creation, it operates “Monozukuri Service,” providing machining technology, automation solutions and even the know-how for building smart factories developed at its own plants.
entries.2b21f66350788eec: This is a business in which local subsidiaries in China, Taiwan, Australia, Thailand and other countries manufacture and sell machine tools and provide after-sales service; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,686 million. In China, demand from semiconductor manufacturing equipment, wind power generation, general industrial machinery and other sectors remained steady, and the company received a large-scale investment project order from a major EV manufacturer. There are manufacturing bases in Beijing, Taiwan and Changzhou.
entries.317b2e3b145deb8d: The company consists of the company itself, 16 consolidated subsidiaries and 15 non-consolidated subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026). Consolidated headcount is 4,101 (fiscal year ended March 2026). The head office is in Oguchi-cho, Niwa-gun, Aichi Prefecture, and machine tools are produced mainly at domestic plants.
entries.39ba16cbf0c99943: This is a business in which the local subsidiaries in the U.S. and Brazil sell machine tools and provide after-sales service; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥68,495 million. In the U.S., demand from major companies in aerospace, space and satellites, defense-related fields, medical equipment, and data center and energy-related sectors remained firm. Sales to Morris Group, Inc., a major customer, were ¥24,221 million, and sales to Gosiger Machine Tools, LLC were ¥23,701 million.

entries.469ece93939f189d: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,554 million, up 30.9% from the previous year. Amid the effects of rising material costs, persistently high transportation costs and strengthened investment in human capital, the company is focusing on cost reduction through improved production efficiency and expanded in-house production, and is working to pass on cost increases and the burden of U.S. tariffs to selling prices.
entries.4aba0949aa7aa39d: It is one of the world's leading general machine tool manufacturers, developing in-house the numerical control devices (NC devices) that control machine tools, and has a structure in which it handles everything related to machine tools in-house, from machinery technology to control technology, from hardware to software, and from pre-sales to after-sales service. A further feature is that it can offer automation and intelligence know-how proven at its own smart factories as solutions for customers.
entries.4d55324a29294ea2: This is a business that manufactures and sells machine tools in Japan and provides after-sales service; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥117,355 million, the largest of the four reportable segments. The company is responsible for manufacturing and sales, and consolidated subsidiaries handle parts processing, assembly, machine design and the manufacture of sheet metal parts. In the second half of the year, capital investment began to pick up across various industries, including aerospace, space and defense-related fields, as well as general industrial machinery, shipbuilding, power generation-related and medical equipment.
entries.4df055c4f180becd: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥235,888 million, up 14.1% from the previous year.

entries.566bdc8055243da9: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥235,888 million, up 14.1% from the previous year. Revenue by product was ¥132,309 million for machining centers, ¥60,763 million for multitasking machines and ¥34,304 million for NC lathes.
entries.5ac3c736de61e42e: Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥117,355 million in Japan, ¥68,495 million in the Americas, ¥34,351 million in Europe and ¥15,686 million in Asia-Pacific, with roughly half of total revenue from Japan and the remainder from overseas.
